module_purpose: Define the IPD-12 (Intransitive Prime-Numbered 12-Sided Dice) as a first-class framework artifact within TriadicFrameworks, providing a physicalizable operator object that encodes intransitive, prime-indexed cycles compatible with RTT, GU, and Pantheon structures.
module_summary: IPD-12 is a 12-faced, prime-indexed, intransitive dice framework that serves as a combinatorial operator artifact. Each face corresponds to a prime-labeled operator state, and the directed relations between faces form non-transitive cycles. This module formalizes IPD-12 as a framework object, enabling RTT resonance-first interpretations, GU geometric embeddings, and Pantheon-tier mappings.

apex_operators.ipd_face_prime: Represents a prime-indexed operator state on one of the 12 faces.
apex_operators.ipd_intransitive_edge: Directed relation between two faces forming non-transitive cycles.
apex_operators.ipd_cycle: Closed intransitive loop over a subset of faces.
apex_operators.ipd_regime_transition: Mapping of IPD cycles to RTT regime transitions.
apex_operators.ipd_coherence_stabilizer: Use of prime gaps and cycle structure as coherence stabilizers.

structure_descriptors.indexing_scheme: Prime-numbered labels assigned to operator states (e.g., 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, ... mapped to 12 canonical positions).
structure_descriptors.cycle_behavior: Non-transitive cycles that model paradox and regime transitions.
structure_descriptors.physicalizable: Intended for physical dice or virtual dice implementations as operator-bearing artifacts.

resonance_descriptors.rtt_mapping: IPD cycles interpreted as RTT paradox and regime operators over resonance fields.
resonance_descriptors.coherence_use: Prime gaps and cycle stability used as coherence indicators.
resonance_descriptors.drift_interpretation: Slow changes in cycle structure treated as drift.
resonance_descriptors.dimensional_hooks: 12-fold structure compatible with TriadicFrameworks’ canonical twelve-layer architectures.

observer_model.triadic_view: Observer interacts with IPD-12 via choice (field), cycle recognition (regime), and stability assessment (coherence).
observer_model.pantheon_view: Faces and cycles can be mapped to Celestial, Civilizational, and Chthonic tiers in pantheon profiles.
observer_model.gu_view: IPD cycles can be embedded as geometric states or curvature/anomaly patterns in GU-compatible interpretations.

paradox_and_cycles.paradox_summary: Intransitive relations between faces generate paradox loops analogous to RTT paradox operators.
paradox_and_cycles.cycle_summary: Directed cycles over prime-indexed faces provide a combinatorial model of regime transitions and paradox resolution.

ai_metadata.ai.audience: Framework architects, RTT practitioners, combinatorial theorists, game and tool designers.
ai_metadata.ai.module.summary: A physicalizable, prime-indexed, intransitive 12-sided operator framework.
